definitions.explanation: To physically place objects on top of each other in layers.
To gradually gather or amass things over time, especially abstract things like experience, effort, or achievements.

examples.japanese: ⟦{段|だん}ボール→段ボール：18885_danbooru⟧⟦{箱|ばこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{積|つ}み{重|かさ}ねて⟦{収納|しゅうのう}→収納：07497_shuunou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I stacked the cardboard boxes for storage.

examples.japanese: ⟦レンガ→レンガ：19408_renga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}に→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧{積|つ}み{重|かさ}ねて⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I carefully stacked the bricks to build a wall.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{積|つ}み{重|かさ}ねる⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{積|つ}み{重|かさ}ねて、⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: After accumulating years of effort, I finally succeeded.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧⟦{実績|じっせき}→実績：04214_jisseki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{積|つ}み{重|かさ}ねる⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{周囲|しゅうい}→周囲：03206_shuui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}た→得る：02014_eru⟧。
examples.english: By building up small achievements, I earned the trust of those around me.

notes:
USAGE: {積|つ}み{重|かさ}ねる is a compound verb combining ⟦{積|つ}む→積む：02294_tsumu⟧ (to pile) and ⟦{重|かさ}ねる→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧ (to stack, to repeat). The figurative use (sense 2) is more common than the literal use.

TRANSITIVITY: Transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧). Takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ for the object being accumulated.

ASPECT: {積|つ}み{重|かさ}ねて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates ongoing accumulation or a state of having accumulated over time.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{積|つ}み{重|かさ}ねる (to accumulate effort)
- ⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{積|つ}み{重|かさ}ねる (to build up experience)
- ⟦{実績|じっせき}→実績：04214_jisseki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{積|つ}み{重|かさ}ねる (to build up achievements)
- ⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{積|つ}み{重|かさ}ねる (to accumulate practice)

RELATED: The intransitive form ⟦{積|つ}み{重|かさ}なる→積み重なる：19542_tsumikasanaru⟧ means "to pile up" or "to accumulate" naturally without an agent.
